nuggets.text: Dowell Loggains walked on at Arkansas in 2000 as a quarterback and holder, and now leads the Mountaineers in his second season.
Dowell Loggains coached NFL quarterbacks Jay Cutler, Vince Young and Sam Darnold before taking over in Boone.
Malachi Singleton went 22-of-24 for 291 yards and three touchdowns in the Mountaineers' opener against Maine.
Malachi Singleton ran in the game-winning touchdown against No. 4 Tennessee for Arkansas in 2024, before stops at Purdue and Boone.
The Mountaineers strung together nine straight scoring drives in their season opener against Maine.
The 55-3 win over Maine was the Mountaineers' largest margin of victory since a 72-7 win over Gardner-Webb in 2018.
The Mountaineers have won the last three meetings with East Carolina, most recently 21-19 in Greenville in 2024.
The Mountaineers stunned No. 5 Michigan 34-32 in 2007, the first time an FCS team beat a ranked FBS program.
Kidd Brewer Stadium was the first venue in North or South Carolina to install artificial turf, back in 1970.
Yosef, the Mountaineers' mascot, is named for mountain talk for 'yourself,' and his rifle fires after every touchdown.
